description.value: Laila Laila Hotpot bills itself as Victoria's only all-you-can-eat Chinese hotpot restaurant, co-founded by two Shanghai natives who spent six months in Sichuan developing their signature soup base recipes. The menu spans 35–60+ items across Classic and Premium tiers, covering premium meats, seafood, vegetables, fried snacks, and ice cream. The name 'LailaLaila' is a Shanghainese expression of warm welcome — fitting for a touring cyclist looking for a hearty, communal meal.

address.value: 1540 Cedar Hill Cross Rd, Victoria, BC, V8P 2P4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the business is open as an all-you-can-eat hotpot restaurant in Victoria. However, the website consistently lists a different address (1540 Cedar Hill Cross Rd, V8P 2P4) and a different phone number (250-590-6696) than OSM (1546 Cedar Hill Cross Road, V8T 1N3; +1-250-388-9806), so the website values are used per rule 12 and discrepancies flagged. The website prominently features a 'Take Out Menu' link confirming takeout availability; no other cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
